description: This is an abstract class defining the interface for authentication providers within the OrangeHRM system. It declares methods for authenticating and priority retrieval but does not implement them, serving as a base class for specific authentication strategies.
external_methods: AuthParamsInterface:: (methods not specified, but it is used as a parameter)

classes.name: AbstractAuthProvider
classes.description: An abstract base class for authentication providers, defining the necessary interface for authentication and priority methods.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Abstract method to authenticate given authentication parameters, returning true if authentication is successful, otherwise false. May throw AuthenticationException.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the priority of the authentication provider.
